notes.title: Armada Pet Wars Patch 0.31.624.04
notes.content: [p][/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/eff19296b7e8f0fa73cbb913996f74a0a26a4588.png"][/img]     Patch 0.31.624.04[/h1][p][/p][h3]BUG - auto update not updating to two levels on a component if the first is not researched[/h3][p][/p][h3]setup more game resolutions, restrict invalid ones for display being used[/h3][p]There are now 324 potential resolution combinations, but to simplify and avoid screen errors, I have the current display scanned for its max width and height to only offer resolutions on those boundaries.  [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/23f5c4adcf96b765cd767fb76067376a6dd9d23d.png"][/img][/p][h3]move local options out of game options[/h3][p]This is in preparation for my deeper dive into figuring out cloud saves with Steam. My first attempt was a fail, but hopefully by separating screen size and sounds from game options this will work better for people playing APW on a PC and on a Steamdeck.[/p][p][/p][h3]change market orders, remove 5 orders and add 10000 instead[/h3][p]During testing I'm noticing that large orders are common, this allows for 10000 units at a time to be transacted with one button push.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/f9c728d22b15bf5f3547174b8f047d2e361e7bed.png"][/img][/p]

tags.bug: BUG - auto update not updating to two levels on a component if the first is not researched

tags.feature: setup more game resolutions, restrict invalid ones for display being used
move local options out of game options

tags.balance_change: change market orders, remove 5 orders and add 10000 instead

notes.title: Armada Pet Wars Patch 0.31.61602
notes.content: [h1]Patch 0.31.61602[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45639174/eff19296b7e8f0fa73cbb913996f74a0a26a4588.png"][/img][/p][h3]change fullscreen to windowed fullscreen[/h3][p]fullscreen has now been modified to windowless, which works better based on initial testing.[/p][p][/p][h3]show fleets that don't have all ships assigned for tactics if tactics are available[/h3][p]fleet icons now will pulse if there are ships that need to be placed in the tactics screen to remind the player.[/p][p][/p][h3]make adding ships to ship tactics auto select left-most ship[/h3][p]fleet tactics are a little faster to implement.[/p][p][/p]

tags.feature: show fleets that don't have all ships assigned for tactics if tactics are available
make adding ships to ship tactics auto select left-most ship
